Name: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 3
Overview: Professional Yakyuu Spirits 3 (プロ野球スピリッツ3, Pro Yakyū Spirits 3) is a baseball simulation game designed for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 2 systems. The game was released on April 6, 2006 and is developed and published by Konami. It is the third game in the series and it is the spin-off of MLB Power Pro series.
